results.title: Audiovisual Translation - Taking Stock | PDF | Translations | Linguistics
results.content: This chapter provides an overview of the field of audiovisual translation (AVT) and discusses its development within Translation Studies. It notes that AVT is seen as one of the most thrivin…. It notes that AVT is seen as one of the most thriving branches of Translation Studies due to its close connection to technology and constant developments. While AVT still draws on foundational works in Translation Studies, it is pursuing multiple new avenues of research and calling on knowledge from various other disciplines. This raises the question of whether AVT has outgrown Translation Studies to become an interdiscipline or autonomous field in its own right.
